evidence_limits: No complete audiovisual or slide-image review.

No source benchmark, large neural training or speed claim reproduced.
Homogeneous uniformization proof, asymmetric example, correlated pair and fitting code are original educational derivations.

Author checks do not constitute independent scientific acceptance.
